info.title: IntentDataPlaneService
info.description: Intent authoring and matching API for one Router. An intent is a named classification with example phrasings and an optional dispatch target; matching returns the intents closest to a query. Intents and examples are ordered lists: they are returned in the order they were created.

post.description: Removes everything the scope names. With INTENTS every intent and example of the Router is deleted and the Router itself stays. The scope is required: there is no default.

parameters.description: Opaque Router identifier.

put.description: Creates or replaces one intent. Idempotent: the same request twice yields the same state. 201 when the intent is new, 200 when it replaced one, which keeps its place in the list. Existing phrasings absent from the request are removed after the new ones are written, so a concurrent match never sees an empty intent.

A relevance score in [0, 1]. Higher is closer, and every threshold in the API
(`minScore`) points the same way: higher is stricter.

examples.description: Example phrasings, kept in the order given. May be empty: an intent without examples never matches.

IntentMetadata.description: Optional descriptive labels (owner, tags). Dispatch data belongs in the target; the keys type, ref, target and args are rejected.

nextCursor.description: Present when more examples follow; pass it back as cursor.
